facts.business: Indian Metals and Ferro Alloys Ltd is a fully integrated producer of ferro chrome in India, with operations spanning captive chromite mining, power generation, smelting, and exports.

capacity_or_capex.timeline: final phase of commissioning in FY 2025-26

key_risks: Inventory existence and valuation risk due to volumetric measurement complexities across multiple locations
Commodity price risk for chrome ore, coal, met coke and ferro chrome
Interest rate risk on debt mutual fund investments
Credit risk from trade receivables and financial instruments
facts.related_party_note: No materially significant related party transactions which have potential conflict with the interest of the Company at large. Policy on materiality of Related Party Transactions hosted on company website.
